scripts.build: pnpm run build:jsonschema && pnpm run build:bigquery
scripts.build:jsonschema: pnpm exec typescript-json-schema ../types/src/snapshot.ts Snapshot --required -o tmp/snapshot.jsonschema && pnpm exec typescript-json-schema ../types/src/loanSnapshot.ts LoanSnapshot --required -o tmp/loanSnapshot.jsonschema
scripts.build:bigquery: pnpm exec jsbq -j tmp/snapshot.jsonschema > schemas/snapshot.json && pnpm exec jsbq -j tmp/loanSnapshot.jsonschema > schemas/loanSnapshot.json
